cohort: Patients undergoing cesarean section over a 6-year period in a tertiary hospital
finding: Preoperative moderate thrombocytopenia (platelet count 50-100 × 10(9)/L) was not associated with increased blood loss or other adverse outcomes in patients undergoing cesarean section without additional bleeding risk.
mod_finding: Preoperative moderate thrombocytopenia is not associated with increased blood loss or need for blood transfusion during cesarean section in patients without additional bleeding risks.
